about: T2c classes of Bolorgir errors in T8a on the core 6e62e0d1 (t8a_report.py --t2c, run_t8a.sh T8A_T2C) for the wheel rebuilt after the 2026-10-11 comment cleanup. Same classes as the owner decision of 2026-10-10 (kept in t2c.json); only wheel_sha256 is re-pinned to that wheel. A class covers only its file with the exact outcome it names as status, under the T8a protocol of that run (wheel 51143746, Llama 3.1 revision a2856192, 900 s per file, one worker): the status timeout is a pending marker whose chunk ended with exit -14 (the runner's SIGALRM) while it ran the file; t8a_report.py applies the class only then, so a crash with another exit, a validation error or a marker without that chunk end stays open. The table status crash_or_timeout stays. A timeout of any other file is not covered and stays open. The causes inside the core are open. The protocol block states those limits in complete machine-readable form; t8a_report.py applies a class only when every required condition is present with the run's value, otherwise every case stays open.
